name: CamSeen
desc: set by INT4 when the cam sensor rises

name: StrobeBufB
desc: toggled per burst: 0 = table A; 1 = table B

name: LineBufFill
desc: refill the line buffer from SRAM

name: EndMarkMask
desc: hide 'image data full' in replies until a status poll

name: TickRunning
desc: normal 10.24 ms tick (cleared in idle, where the tick is 1 s)

name: PowerOnLock
desc: set at boot; cleared when homing ends; packets answered 0xFF meanwhile

name: SupplyCut
desc: P5.3 has been cleared after low battery

name: RxInPacket
desc: receiver coroutine is waiting for a byte

name: LowBatReported
desc: a reply has carried the low-battery bit

name: RxIsData
desc: current packet is a data packet

name: ColdHead
desc: every row heat is zero: use the cold tick curves

name: SyncLostBusy
desc: sync lost while printing: treat packets as junk until the job ends

name: BreakBlock
desc: after Break: data packets give a packet error until Init

name: AfterPrint
desc: a print was accepted (next data starts a new image)

name: SioRearm
desc: serial watchdog armed: re-arm SIO2 after SioIdleTimer if no packet is in progress

name: BattSample
desc: first strobe burst of a job: read the battery under load (low battery at <= 0x7E, or a sag of 8 below BattAtStart when <= 0x9C)
